---
title: Scholar metadata for a key defined in two bibliographies
format: html
google-scholar: true
bibliography: [first.bib, second.bib]
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElementCount:
        - selectors: ['meta[name="citation_reference"]', '.csl-entry[id^="ref-"]']
          counts: [1, 1]
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_author=Bob Jones;"]']
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_author=Alice Smith;"]']
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['id="ref-shared"[^>]*>\s*Jones, Bob']
        - []
---

Pandoc keeps the entry from the last bibliography that defines a key [@shared].
